visits.title: Initial Comprehensive Consultation & Chronic Care Intake
visits.reason: Evaluation of poorly controlled hypertension, newly diagnosed T2D, and recurrent RUQ pain
visits.notes: SOAP Note: S: Patient reports 3 months of intermittent morning tension headaches, bilateral calf heaviness, and recurrent right upper quadrant fullness after fatty meals. O: BP 158/96 mmHg, Pulse 82 bpm, SpO2 98%, Temp 36.8°C, Random Blood Glucose 174 mg/dL, Weight 78.4 kg, BMI 29.8. Mild tenderness at Murphy's point; no peritoneal signs. Heart sounds regular S1/S2 without murmurs. Lungs clear. A: 1. Essential Hypertension, uncontrolled. 2. Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, newly confirmed (HbA1c 8.4%). 3. Suspected symptomatic cholelithiasis vs biliary colic. P: 1. Prescribe Concor 2.5 mg PO daily for rate and pressure control. 2. Prescribe Cidophage 500 mg PO BID with meals. 3. Order abdominal ultrasound and complete metabolic/lipid panel. 4. Dietary education regarding low-fat, low-glycemic Mediterranean plan.

visits.title: Cardiovascular & Hepatobiliary Review
visits.reason: Review ultrasound imaging results and blood pressure titration
visits.notes: SOAP Note: S: Headaches significantly reduced. Still experiencing post-prandial RUQ cramping after fried food. O: BP 142/88 mmHg, Pulse 76 bpm, SpO2 99%, Fasting Glucose 148 mg/dL. Abdomen soft. Ultrasound reviewed: multiple mobile gallstones with acoustic shadowing, gallbladder wall 2.8mm, CBD 4.2mm. EGD shows mild antral erythema without ulcer. A: 1. Cholelithiasis with recurrent biliary colic. 2. Hypertension improving on beta-blockade. 3. T2D suboptimally controlled. P: 1. Refer to general surgery for elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy. 2. Increase Concor to 5 mg daily. 3. Add Amaryl 2 mg daily for glycemic boost. 4. Order pre-op clearance tests.

visits.title: Pre-Operative Cardiopulmonary Clearance
visits.reason: Surgical clearance for elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy
visits.notes: SOAP Note: S: Patient feels calm and ready for scheduled laparoscopy. Denies exertional dyspnea, chest pressure, orthopnea, or ankle swelling. O: BP 130/82 mmHg, Pulse 72 bpm, SpO2 99%, Lungs resonant and clear throughout. Echocardiogram: LVEF 62%, Grade 1 diastolic dysfunction, normal LV size. ECG shows normal sinus rhythm at 72 bpm. A: ASA Class II. Medically cleared for general anesthesia and laparoscopic cholecystectomy. P: Hold oral hypoglycemic medications on the morning of surgery. Concor 5 mg may be taken with a sip of water early on operative morning. Fasting from midnight.

visits.title: Post-Operative Review (Day 10 Post-Cholecystectomy)
visits.reason: Surgical wound check and post-op metabolic review
visits.notes: SOAP Note: S: Patient reports steady surgical recovery. Minor port soreness well controlled with acetaminophen. Tolerating light soups and bland diet without nausea. Home blood glucose readings 68–74 mg/dL on reduced intake. O: BP 126/78 mmHg, Pulse 70 bpm, Temp 36.6°C, SpO2 99%. Four laparoscopic puncture incisions clean, dry, healing per primam, no signs of cellulitis or seroma. Abdomen soft and non-tender. Bowel sounds active. A: 1. Satisfactory recovery post-laparoscopic cholecystectomy. Histopathology confirmed chronic cholecystitis with cholelithiasis, benign. 2. Transient mild fasting hypoglycemia due to reduced post-op calories. P: 1. Pause Amaryl (Glimepiride) 2 mg immediately to avoid hypoglycemia. 2. Initiate Omeprazole 20 mg daily for 8 weeks to alleviate mild post-op reflux/dyspepsia. 3. Continue Concor 5 mg and Cidophage 500 mg BID. Remove skin sutures/steri-strips.

visits.title: 6-Month Metabolic & Bone Health Surveillance
visits.reason: Routine metabolic monitoring and review of DEXA bone density scan
visits.notes: SOAP Note: S: Completely free from abdominal pain. Walking 5 km weekly in local park. Mild lower back stiffness after prolonged sitting. O: BP 124/80 mmHg, Pulse 68 bpm, Weight 75.8 kg (down 2.6 kg from intake). DEXA scan reviewed: Lumbar spine T-score -1.8, left femoral neck T-score -1.6 (osteopenia). Labs: HbA1c 7.1%, Fasting Glucose 122 mg/dL, 25-OH Vitamin D 18 ng/mL (deficient). A: 1. Post-cholecystectomy status: fully resolved. 2. T2D improving on Cidophage monotherapy. 3. Osteopenia and Vitamin D deficiency. P: 1. Prescribe Caltrate 600 mg + Vitamin D3 400 IU daily. 2. Titrate Cidophage from 500 mg BID to 1000 mg BID. 3. Discontinue Amaryl permanently. 4. Continue Concor 5 mg. 5. Taper Omeprazole over the next 2 weeks and stop.

visits.title: Quarterly Cardiovascular & Lipid Optimization
visits.reason: Evaluation of lipid panel and cardiovascular targets
visits.notes: SOAP Note: S: Excellent adherence to walking regimen and medications. No acid reflux symptoms after stopping Omeprazole. O: BP 122/78 mmHg, Pulse 72 bpm, Weight 74.5 kg. Labs: HbA1c 6.8%, Fasting Glucose 106 mg/dL, Total Cholesterol 198 mg/dL, LDL 124 mg/dL. A: 1. Well-controlled essential hypertension. 2. Glycemic control approaching target. 3. Mixed dyslipidemia: LDL 124 mg/dL remains above guideline target (< 100 mg/dL for diabetic profile). P: 1. Titrate Lipitor from 20 mg to 40 mg PO at bedtime. 2. Maintain Concor 5 mg, Cidophage 1000 mg BID, and Caltrate + D3 daily. 3. Recheck lipid and metabolic panel in 3 months.

visits.title: Comprehensive Follow-up & Biomarker Attainment
visits.reason: Evaluation of Lipitor 40mg response and metabolic optimization
visits.notes: SOAP Note: S: Patient reports feeling vibrant and energetic. Has maintained 45-minute daily brisk walking routine. Zero muscle aches or cramps on Lipitor 40mg. O: BP 120/76 mmHg, Pulse 70 bpm, Weight 73.6 kg. Labs: HbA1c 6.5%, Fasting Glucose 98 mg/dL, LDL down to 94 mg/dL (target < 100 achieved!), ALT 24 U/L, AST 22 U/L, Creatinine 0.84 mg/dL. A: 1. Excellent glycemic control (HbA1c 6.5%). 2. Target LDL achieved (< 100 mg/dL) on Atorvastatin 40 mg. 3. Blood pressure optimal. P: Continue all current medications without adjustment. Schedule annual longitudinal review.

visits.title: Annual Longitudinal Maintenance & Telehealth Review
visits.reason: Annual chronic disease review, telemetry sync, and preventive screening
visits.notes: SOAP Note: S: Patient reports overall wellbeing is the highest in years. Home BP logs consistent at 120/76 - 124/80 mmHg. Zero hypoglycemic spells. Good calcium intake. O: BP 122/78 mmHg, Pulse 70 bpm, SpO2 99%, Temp 36.7°C, Weight 73.1 kg, BMI 27.8 (-5.3 kg total weight reduction). Labs: HbA1c 6.4%, Fasting Glucose 96 mg/dL, Total Chol 172 mg/dL, LDL 94 mg/dL, 25-OH Vit D 34 ng/mL (normalized). A: 1. Well-controlled Type 2 Diabetes (HbA1c 6.4% on Metformin monotherapy). 2. Optimal hypertension control on Concor 5 mg. 3. Stable dyslipidemia on Lipitor 40 mg. 4. Osteopenia on active prophylaxis. P: 1. Reassure patient on outstanding progress and lifestyle modifications. 2. Refill Concor 5 mg, Cidophage 1000 mg BID, Lipitor 40 mg, Caltrate + D3. 3. Repeat DEXA scan in 12 months. Next clinic review scheduled for April 2027.

imaging.title: Transthoracic Echocardiogram (2D/Doppler)
imaging.reportText: Mild left ventricular concentric hypertrophy. LVEF 60%. Normal diastolic filling parameters.

imaging.title: Renal Duplex Ultrasound
imaging.reportText: Normal bilateral kidney size and cortical echogenicity. No renal artery stenosis identified.

imaging.title: Abdominal & Hepatobiliary Ultrasound
imaging.reportText: Liver demonstrates mild diffuse increased echogenicity consistent with grade 1 hepatic steatosis. No focal hepatic lesion. Gallbladder is well distended, containing multiple shadowing echogenic calculi ranging up to 12 mm, mobile with position change. Gallbladder wall thickness 2.8 mm. Common bile duct is normal caliber at 4.2 mm without ductal dilatation or choledocholithiasis. Spleen and pancreas unremarkable. Impression: Cholelithiasis without acute cholecystitis; mild hepatic steatosis.

imaging.title: Dual-Energy X-Ray Absorptiometry (DEXA Bone Density)
imaging.reportText: Bone density measurement of lumbar spine (L1-L4) and left proximal femur. Lumbar spine BMD is 0.942 g/cm², corresponding to a T-score of -1.8 (Z-score -0.4). Left femoral neck BMD is 0.784 g/cm², corresponding to a T-score of -1.6 (Z-score -0.3). Total hip T-score -1.4. Impression: Osteopenia according to WHO diagnostic criteria. Recommended calcium and vitamin D3 optimization and weight-bearing exercises. FRAX 10-year major osteoporotic fracture probability 6.2%.

imaging.title: Transthoracic 2D & Color Doppler Echocardiogram
imaging.reportText: Cardiac chambers are normal in size. Normal left ventricular wall thickness (interventricular septum 10.5 mm, posterior wall 10 mm). Preserved global LV systolic function with calculated LVEF 62%. No regional wall motion abnormalities. Mitral inflow pattern demonstrates E/A ratio 0.8 with prolonged deceleration time, consistent with Grade I diastolic dysfunction secondary to chronic systemic hypertension. Aortic and mitral valves are structurally normal with trivial regurgitation.

procedures.notes: Four-port laparoscopy under GA. Gallbladder inflamed with multiple faceted stones. Critical view of safety identified. Cystic duct and artery clipped and divided. Specimen extracted intact. Uneventful recovery.
